"I’m listening."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"

"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."

"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."
"Alright. Catch you later."

"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

"Yes."
They nod. "Okay."
"Go on. I'm listening."

"Tell me more."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the north treeline by the fallen oak."
"Tell me why you need this."
